diagram_math_checks.objects_and_domains: H=C^2 with ordered orthonormal basis |0>,|1>; X is an arbitrary element of L(H)=M_2(C). Both input and output wire carry operators on the same two-dimensional H, not a state vector or two qubits.
diagram_math_checks.maps: The box is Delta:L(H)->L(H), Delta(X)=P0 X P0+P1 X P1, with Pj=|j><j|, each a 2x2 projection. For X=[[a,b],[c,d]], Delta(X)=[[a,0],[0,d]].
diagram_math_checks.relations: The single left-to-right wire reads X -> Delta -> Delta(X). There is no second wire, tensor-product output, inverse arrow, or asserted commuting square.
diagram_math_checks.local_justification: Statement defines Delta; F3 fixes the qubit basis. Proof step 1.1 establishes linearity, positivity of every ancillary amplification and trace preservation via P0+P1=I and trace cyclicity, so the schematic denotes the actual defined channel.
